title: Tank customization in the spec
author: Blitzwing, Tank Designer-Developer
body: Nye decided tanks should be customizable. Every tank spends exactly 9 points across attack, speed and defense (1 to 5 each), so there are 19 fair builds and 3/3/3 stays the default. The arena viewer gets a Customize tab: pick each tank's behavior, set its build on a triangle, see damage, speed, HP and hits to kill, then watch. The seed and builds go in the link, so shared links replay exactly. Tank cards will show "Scripted" today, and training progress once evolution arrives. An item kit is deferred.
next: Nye's GATE-002 review; the engine needs per-tank stats first.
